decisions.reason: As a low-cost service complement to the installed machine base, the training programme is inexpensive to keep available and still offers cross-selling and customer-retention value even if growth is modest.
The fourth rotary axis accessory is a relatively small, closely related add-on whose option value remains positive because it can serve niche customer demand without tying up major resources.

Hybrid additive post-processing looks like the most experimental and uncertain offer in the portfolio, and after several years a medium-sized machinery firm would likely redeploy resources if commercial traction has not clearly emerged.
A high-speed CNC milling machine is costly to support and market, so once uncertainty has had time to resolve the firm is likely to abandon it if it has not become a clear winner in the core range.

The automatic tool change system is a complementary automation product with reasonable strategic fit and lower downside than a full machine platform, so it is worth keeping unless demand clearly disappoints.
